visual_identity.core_identity: A living cave predator whose broad leathery body resembles a hanging cloak until it unfolds into a manta-like creature.
visual_identity.silhouette: Wide triangular mantle body with winglike sides, narrow trailing tail, and a compact underside head near the front edge.
visual_identity.head_features: Small predatory underside face with round eyes and a wide mouth, integrated into the mantle rather than on a neck.
visual_identity.body_shape: Flat flexible ray-like body with broad leathery wings and one long whip-like tail; no humanoid limbs.
visual_identity.surface: Smooth leathery membrane with sparse folds and rib lines.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Broad mantle wings form the main body with one trailing tail; no humanoid arms, legs, or separate bat limbs.

accuracy_checks: reads as a living cloak rather than bat
face remains secondary to body silhouette

known_failure_modes.symptom: creature drifts toward ordinary bat anatomy
known_failure_modes.correction: remove ordinary bat anatomy; restore cloak-like folded silhouette, broad leathery wings, integrated underside face
remove feathers; restore cloak-like folded silhouette, broad leathery wings, integrated underside face
remove humanoid arms; restore cloak-like folded silhouette, broad leathery wings, integrated underside face
